newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian industrial output almost flat in March.
newsitem.headline: Romanian industrial output almost flat in March.

text.p: Romania's industrial output stayed almost flat in March, rising only 0.1 percent after a 10.2 percent monthly growth in February, the National Statistics Board (CNS) said on Thursday.
ROMANIAN INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT MARCH 97 FEB 97 MARCH 96
NOTE: Figures were adjusted according to the number of working days. Data on 1997 are provisional.
"Industrial production was sustained by higher output in the manufacturing sector," CNS president Pavel Wagner told a news conference.

Manufacturing output rose by 16.3 percent in the first quarter, when production in the power sector was two percent down and the extractive production saw a tiny slide of 0.2 percent from the year-ago period.

Wagner said the steel industry, metals and wood working saw higer output in March, while capital goods, including machine and equipment, led industrial production 14.3 percent up over January-March from the same period of 1996.
Industrial output amounted to 13.98 trillion lei in March, with the three-month figure at 30.23 trillion.
Inventories accounted for 54.7 percent of March production, sharply down from 65.1 percent in February, but Wagner said the level of textiles and dye products stocks remained high.
Some 21 percent of the first quarter's output was exported, the CNS said.
Industry employed 2.486 million people at end-March, 10,500 less than the previous month.
